session-2026-09-09-plumbing-track.title: Plumbing Track implementation ledger — 2026-09-09
session-2026-09-09-plumbing-track.content: Comprehensive record for the live pt-site-updates implementation session. Scope: homepage rebuild; Book an Assessment conversion flow; global navigation and footer; Our Work proof library; visual palette, spacing, typography, and responsive repairs; verification and failures. Child records capture each implementation group, regression, and live validation.

implementation-homepage.title: Rebuilt the homepage as a compact conversion journey

implementation-shared-chrome.title: Centralized navigation and footer as shared fragments
implementation-shared-chrome.content: {"change":"Created fetched header and footer fragments, routed assessment CTAs through the shared header, added icon-only social links, implemented click-away menu dismissal, standardized navigation order as About, Our Work, Solutions, How It Works, Our Technology, Resources, applied the same header fragment to homepage, Our Work, BC Housing, Client Portal, and Meadowbrooks portal page, and placed the zero-duration transparent-to-white header swap in the fragment itself.","component":"templates/site-header.html, templates/site-footer.html, site-header.js, shared-navigation.css, app.js"}

semantic.change: Created fetched header and footer fragments, routed assessment CTAs through the shared header, added icon-only social links, implemented click-away menu dismissal, standardized navigation order as About, Our Work, Solutions, How It Works, Our Technology, Resources, applied the same header fragment to homepage, Our Work, BC Housing, Client Portal, and Meadowbrooks portal page, and placed the zero-duration transparent-to-white header swap in the fragment itself.

implementation-visual-hygiene.title: Applied visual hygiene across site pages
implementation-visual-hygiene.content: {"change":"Replaced the rejected light cyan treatment with gold and dark blue, removed numbered section labels and superfluous commentary copy, reduced footer logo size, compacted sections, standardized independent arrow-marker alignment, and applied orphan-aware heading wrapping with targeted non-breaking phrases.","component":"index.html, our-work/index.html, assessment/index.html, bchousing/index.html, client-portal/index.html, client-portal/meadowbrooks-estates/index.html"}

semantic.change: Replaced the rejected light cyan treatment with gold and dark blue, removed numbered section labels and superfluous commentary copy, reduced footer logo size, compacted sections, standardized independent arrow-marker alignment, and applied orphan-aware heading wrapping with targeted non-breaking phrases.
